<explanation>
Structured data format with labeled fields ("Event:", "Outcome:") signals a template-style prompt for a fictional narrative entry, constraining output to follow the same pattern.

The instruction "Record one event" establishes a single, self-contained fictional scenario about a specific action ("a man throws a ball"), implying a brief, complete narrative summary is expected.

"Record complete." is a closing delimiter phrase, mirroring the opening "Record start." framing, suggesting the next token likely begins a new instruction, response, or system prompt boundary.
"Record start. Event: [description]. Outcome: [description]. Record complete." — the final phrase "Record complete." serves as a terminal marker, so the next token likely closes the prompt or signals end of input, e.g., "End." or a period.
</explanation>
